description: Initial E8 suite: reconstructions of the sixteen article edge probes, nine Lean-core examples, and four impossible-contract controls. Not an external benchmark import. References are withheld from synthesis.

cases.title: Append two lists
cases.type: List Nat → List Nat → List Nat

cases.title: Compute two to a natural power
Sum a list and execute the bound candidate
Head of a nonempty indexed vector
cases.prelude:
inductive ExtendedVec (A : Type) : Nat → Type where
  | nil : ExtendedVec A 0
  | cons {n : Nat} : A → ExtendedVec A n → ExtendedVec A (n + 1)
cases.reference: fun _ _ xs => match xs with | .cons x _ => x

cases.title: Map over an indexed vector
cases.prelude:
inductive ExtendedVec (A : Type) : Nat → Type where
  | nil : ExtendedVec A 0
  | cons {n : Nat} : A → ExtendedVec A n → ExtendedVec A (n + 1)
cases.type: ∀ (A B : Type), (A → B) → ∀ n, ExtendedVec A n → ExtendedVec B n
cases.replay: (match @{f} Nat Nat Nat.succ 2 (.cons 1 (.cons 3 .nil)) with | .cons a (.cons b .nil) => a == 2 && b == 4) = true
cases.reference: fun A B f _ xs => let rec go {n : Nat} (ys : ExtendedVec A n) : ExtendedVec B n := match ys with | .nil => .nil | .cons x rest => .cons (f x) (go rest); go xs

cases.title: Drop zero entries from a list
Flatten a binary tree in order
cases.prelude:
inductive ExtendedTree (A : Type) where
  | leaf : ExtendedTree A
  | node : ExtendedTree A → A → ExtendedTree A → ExtendedTree A
cases.reference: fun xs => let rec go (ys : ExtendedTree Nat) : List Nat := match ys with | .leaf => [] | .node l x r => go l ++ [x] ++ go r; go xs

cases.title: Existential witness from a local proof
cases.type: ∀ P : Nat → Prop, P 3 → ∃ n, P n

cases.title: Symmetry of equality
cases.type: ∀ (A : Type) (a b : A), a = b → b = a

cases.title: Transitivity of natural ordering
cases.type: ∀ a b c : Nat, a ≤ b → b ≤ c → a ≤ c
cases.reference: fun _ _ _ h₁ h₂ => Nat.le_trans h₁ h₂

cases.title: List.map equations at concrete arguments
cases.type: ∀ A B : Type, (A → B) → List A → List B
cases.contract: {f} Nat Nat Nat.succ [] = [] ∧ {f} Nat Nat Nat.succ [1, 3] = [2, 4] ∧ {f} Nat Bool (fun n => n == 0) [0, 2] = [true, false]
cases.reference: fun _ _ f xs => List.map f xs

cases.title: List.head? constructor equations
cases.type: ∀ A : Type, List A → Option A
cases.contract: {f} Nat [] = none ∧ {f} Nat [7, 9] = some 7 ∧ {f} Bool [false, true] = some false

cases.title: List.tail constructor equations
cases.type: ∀ A : Type, List A → List A

cases.title: Option.map constructor equations
cases.type: ∀ A B : Type, (A → B) → Option A → Option B
cases.contract: {f} Nat Nat Nat.succ none = none ∧ {f} Nat Nat Nat.succ (some 4) = some 5 ∧ {f} Nat Bool (fun n => n == 0) (some 0) = some true
cases.reference: fun _ _ f x => Option.map f x

cases.title: Option.getD constructor equations
cases.type: ∀ A : Type, Option A → A → A
cases.contract: {f} Nat none 7 = 7 ∧ {f} Nat (some 3) 7 = 3 ∧ {f} Bool (some false) true = false
cases.reference: fun _ x d => Option.getD x d

cases.title: Option.isSome constructor equations
cases.contract: {f} Nat none = false ∧ {f} Nat (some 3) = true ∧ {f} Bool (some false) = true

cases.title: Nat.pred constructor equations
cases.source: Lean v4.34.0 Init/Data/Nat/Basic.lean:909-910 Nat.pred_zero, Nat.pred_succ (Nat elimination)

cases.title: Universal natural addition right identity
cases.source: Lean v4.34.0 Init/Data/Nat/Basic.lean:140 uses Nat.add_zero in its right identity instance

cases.title: Impossible option contract
cases.type: ∀ A : Type, Option A → A → A

cases.title: Impossible contract on an inhabited theorem
cases.type: ∀ (A : Type) (a b : A), a = b → b = a
